title: Template:ImageSplit
text: Text on the left and a picture on the right. The picture is cropped to the height of the text, so the two always line up. Usage {{ImageSplit|image=Thunderwing_Titan_artwork.jpg|alt=Thunderwing Titan| The text, cards and so on go here. }} image is the file name without File:. alt is the text for screen readers. width (optional) is the width in pixels that is loaded, default 600. link (optional) is a page to open when the picture is clicked. Empty means no link. If the text contains an equals sign, write text= in front of it. On narrow windows and phones the picture goes under the text. Needs Template:ImageSplit/styles.css. Text on the left and a picture on the right, cropped to the same height. html:
Text on the left and a picture on the right. The picture is cropped to the height of the text, so the two always line up.

Usage 

{{ImageSplit|image=Thunderwing_Titan_artwork.jpg|alt=Thunderwing Titan|
The text, cards and so on go here.
}}
  • image is the file name without File:. alt is the text for screen readers.
  • width (optional) is the width in pixels that is loaded, default 600.
  • link (optional) is a page to open when the picture is clicked. Empty means no link.
  • If the text contains an equals sign, write text= in front of it.
  • On narrow windows and phones the picture goes under the text.
  • Needs Template:ImageSplit/styles.css.

Text on the left and a picture on the right, cropped to the same height.
